name: House Mevak
description: An Abzan house led by an ainok who seeks trade for red minerals found in Jeskai lands.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
timeline.quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.
